# The fixtures whose PURPOSE is a bare JSON number token in a wide integer
# field (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §16.2; docs/rulings.json
# json-wide-integers-refuse-number-token). TestJsonFixturesHoldNoBareWideInteger
# (compiler/spec_json_wide_fixtures_strings_test.go) exempts exactly what this
# file names and nothing else; every other shared fixture writes a wide integer
# as a string of digits.
#
# One line each: <manifest> [<row>] # <why the bare token is the point>.
# A line that binds no fixture fails the checker.

testdata/wire/json-integers/NUMBER-TOKEN.tsv # the refused number-token vectors of the json-integers unit
testdata/conformance/tables/JSON-HOSTILE-NUMBER-TOKEN.txt # the json-hostile vectors that write a wide value as a bare number token
internal/ci/hostilecorpus/corpus/number-token.tsv # the shared hostile corpus's copies of the JSON-HOSTILE-NUMBER-TOKEN.txt vectors
